ITEM 1 | Dark purple-red leafy greens with ruffled, torn edges and some lighter green leaves interspersed; covers most of a white square plate's center, roughly 60% of the plate area, leaves piled about 2-3 cm high, slightly glossy and moist, no visible cooking or breading | 110
ITEM 2 | Bright green torn leaves with pale green ribs, scattered across the lower-right and center of the pile, flat and limp with a moist sheen, pieces about 3-6 cm long, sitting among the dark leaves | 35
ITEM 3 | Small dark reddish-brown chunks and pieces, glossy and slightly wet, about 1-2 cm across, clustered in the lower-center of the pile on top of the greens, with a faint red-brown tint suggesting a light dressing coating | 15
ITEM 4 | Thin reddish-brown glossy film or drizzle coating some leaves in the center of the pile, translucent and wet-looking, spread over an area about 6 cm across | 5
